body.text: Gypsum plaster
What is gypsum plaster used for on walls?

runs.text: Gypsum plaster has good insulation properties, fire-resistant and impact-resistant. Also, gypsum saves a lot of time during construction and has superior finish. These properties have clearly drawn attention of real estate builders and contractors towards choosing gypsum plaster over traditional cement plaster.

body.text: Is Gypsum Plaster eco-friendly?

runs.text: Gypsum is an inherently sustainable material as it can be completely recycled an infinite number of times. Removing water from gypsum rocks through dehydration produces a plaster powder scientifically known as calcium sulphate.

body.text: Advantages and disadvantages of Gypsum Plaster?

runs.text: It doesn’t perform well against water We cannot use gypsum plaster for outer walls. These retain dampness and are not the most suitable for areas with walls that come in regular contact with water, such as bathrooms and toilets.

body.text: What is the minimum thickness of Gypsum Plaster?

runs.text: Gypsum Plaster is usually applied in a thickness range of (6 -20)mm. The thickness of the undercoat gypsum plaster is normally 11mm for walls, it’s 8mm for the ceiling area and for that of the finished coat.

body.text: What is the ratio of Gypsum Plaster to water?

runs.text: Water to plaster ratio (1 part of water: 1.25 part of plaster by weight) should be maintained to have a good cohesive workable mix.

body.text: What is the tolerance for Gypsum Walls?

runs.text: The plane and alignment of the panels depend on the plane and alignment of the framing members, backing or devices to which it is attached, and/or conceals. The tolerance of 1/8” in 10′-0” is commonly used in jobsite specifications and referred to as the “industry standard” for flatness in gypsum board finishing.

body.text: What is the coverage of Gypsum Plaster per bag?

runs.text: 20 – 25 Sq. ft. Initial Setting Time: 15 – 20 minutes. Coverage @ thickness of 10 mm: 20 – 25 Sq. ft./Bag of 25 Kg.

body.text: Why is Gypsum Plaster used?

runs.text: Gypsum plastering is an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional sand-cement application for internal plastering surfaces. Gypsum plastering is also a faster application method for internal surfaces, since it does not require a time-consuming water curing process.

body.text: What are the benefits of doing a false ceiling at home?

runs.text: What are the benefits of doing a false ceiling at home? A false ceiling is also known as a dropped ceiling, plays a very important role in home interiors. It is one of the easiest, cost-effective & quickest ways to transform your interior space. There is no limitation to ideas which can come alive as ceilings. Many other functional benefits come along with the aesthetic value of ceilings. Uniform light distribution to the entire room through ceiling lights. Mess-free home with all wirings, pipes covered under the ceiling. Cooler homes with dropped ceilings Express your style through ceiling designs. Ceiling designs can be customized as per room size and lighting requirements.

body.text: How does a ceiling system reduce air conditioning needs & need of more lighting which helps lower electricity bills?

runs.text: False ceilings provide thermal insulation by creating an air gap between the soffit and the false ceiling. They reduce the air volume of a room and, as a result, the air-conditioning load. Thus, the air-conditioning requirement is reduced, resulting in lower electricity bills. Ceilings reflect and diffuse light. A ceiling that reflects and diffuses light well reduces the need for artificial lighting. This results in improved energy efficiency and a better working environment.

body.text: Bonding Agents (Bondit 151 & Plaster Bond+)
How to use Buildon Bonding agents in Gypsum wall plastering?

items.text: Ensure all the surfaces are clean from any contaminants that may hinder adhesion, including any loose or flaking material.
Ensure that the wall is dry.
Thoroughly stir bonding agents before use.
Do not dilute, simply apply a single coat using a brush roller and leave to dry (Bondit 151 for 40 mins & Plaster Bond + for 24 hrs before wall plastering).

body.text: Are Buildon bonding agents alternative to hacking ?

runs.text: Bonding agents are always a better alternative to hacking. Hacking is not only a very crude method of creating bond between Gypsum and Concrete surface but also, it weakens the RCC structure. Hacking is not uniformly distributed since it’s done in a random way. Depth of hacking and pitch of hacking variance over a given surface remains high due to fatigue factor.
